## Environment (required)

<!-- Required. AIEA is a set of instructions that a host runs, so the host and

     reasoned from documentation. -->

| OS + shell | |

## Is this an AIEA issue or a host issue?

<!-- AIEA supplies skills and packaging; the host supplies the model, tools,
     and permissions. Some reported "bugs" are host, model, or network
     behavior. If the problem persists with AIEA uninstalled, it belongs with
     the host instead. -->

- [ ] I confirmed this issue does not occur with AIEA not loaded
